title: Caricature
summary: CARICATURE, noun A figure or description in which beauties are concealed and blemishes exaggerated, but still bearing a resemblance to the object. CARICATURE, verb transitive To make or draw a caricat

inlines.v: CARICATURE, noun A figure or description in which beauties are concealed and blemishes exaggerated, but still bearing a resemblance to the object. CARICATURE, verb transitive To make or draw a caricature; to represent as more ugly than the life.
